notes: A098021_defs_agree (A098021_mathlib.lean): for every integer n, frac((n+2)r) - 2 frac((n+1)r) + frac(nr) - g(frac((n+1)r)) = 0 iff floor(nr+2r) - floor(nr) - floor(2r) = 0 (r = sqrt 2, g = -1/0/1 on [0,1/3], (1/3,2/3], rest); A098021_old_eq_new: the Nat.nth sequences of positive such n coincide.
